Alex Chen: Finance POV — current MDF pool for this quarter is $100k unallocated. We should keep a 10% buffer for retroactive claims.

Marta Gomez: revised proposal: SI 45k, Marketplace 30k, HW 15k, Reserve 10k => totals 100k. Jordan: can HW run with 15k if we add 5 demo units from Redwood credit? :thinking:

AnnounceBot: Calendar event created: "Joint GTM: Orbit+CloudRange+HWCo" on 2026-03-25 10:00 PT — guest list includes Priya, Marta, Samir, Jordan, Alex.

- MDF split table

1) Priya draft MOU + claims template (due Mon)
2) Samir update marketplace checklist (due Thu COB)
3) Jordan confirm demo unit approval (internal) (due Fri)
4) Alex finalize finance sign-off + ledger entry (due Mon)

Priya Nair: noted. Ping me if anyone needs sample MOU from last quarter.
